design: degraded: the article names Stata (xtlogit), but Stata is not installed in this environment. A and B therefore use R, the default stated in workflow.md when Stata is unavailable, and C uses Python. The exact conditional likelihood in R survival::clogit and statsmodels ConditionalLogit is the same likelihood as Stata xtlogit, fe.

checkers.input: manifest.md, grid.json and the code directory only
checkers.output: a bare list of unmet manifest items

isolation.A: Claude CLI with tools Read/Write/Edit/Glob/Grep and Bash restricted to Rscript, the venv python, and ls/head/wc/cat/mkdir. No WebFetch/WebSearch. A network block for Rscript is not enforced; it rests on instructions and must be disclosed.
isolation.B_C: codex workspace-write sandbox: network disabled and writes confined to the staging directory and temp.
isolation.all: neutral staging directory role_<random>; no paper identity, targets, scoring rules or other implementations in the inputs

independence_limit: Both available model families implement, so no independent family remains for the adversarial review. Any discrepancy is therefore withheld as not fully verified (workflow.md section 6).
budget: one main run per implementer; up to 3 checker/repair rounds; every code version preserved
